articles.summary: Dropback for Basketball helps elite men's and women's basketball GMs to translate on-the-court analytics to off-the-court roster decisions. Today, programs can finally work from a modern, unified front-office workspace that’s purpose-built for the Rev-Share Era.
articles.title: NEW: Dropback For Basketball

articles.summary: Dropback, the leading front office software platform for college sports, partners with CBB Analytics—one of college basketball’s most powerful & comprehensive analytics tools—to power data-driven roster construction decisions for GMs.
articles.title: CBB Analytics and Dropback Partner to Power Data-Driven Decisions for Basketball GMs
